roscoe_displacement_lubricator_4_2_physi.external_connection: -Z bottom exit near rear of 4-2 -> bottom U/S-loop -> rear +Z union into 7-9 steam tee
roscoe_displacement_lubricator_4_2_physi.internal_mechanism: Internal vertical brass standpipe (quill) soldered through -Z floor rising to 1.2mm below +Z ceiling of 4-2
roscoe_displacement_lubricator_4_2_physi.transport_chain: Steam enters standpipe -> condenses on tank roof/walls -> water droplets sink via Stokes settling (rho_w > rho_o) -> rising bottom water pool buoyantly lifts floating oil over top lip of internal standpipe -> pure hot low-viscosity oil flows down inside standpipe (isolated from bottom water by brass standpipe wall!) -> bottom U-loop -> 7-9 steam atomization into cylinders.
